'''Taung Heights''' was a region of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="HNN 45" /> The region shared its name with the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]], an ancient [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from Coruscant.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

It was home to much of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|planet-city's]] 145 million [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] residents until the secession of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], at which point much of them left for their [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. This caused the local economy to crumble as much of the Heights' businesses were run by, or catered to, the Aqualish.<ref name="HNN 45" /> [[Latika Garboren]] lived in the area, and [[Dherik Rule]] was served as a [[Detective/Legends|detective]] there.<ref name="HNN 49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|life/13328_2.html|Area Woman Finds Sith Icon in Pastebread}}</ref>
